archetypes.name: Boros Tempo
archetypes.plan: Build a disciplined creature curve, grant haste to maintain pressure, and use first strike to control combat.

archetypes.name: Dimir Control
archetypes.plan: Trade resources early, then use repeatable card draw and discard to dominate a long game.

archetypes.name: Golgari Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Fill the graveyard through trades and dredge, recur the best creatures, and grow the threats that remain.

archetypes.name: Selesnya Tokens
archetypes.plan: Create a wide Saproling board, convoke larger spells ahead of curve, and finish with a team-wide boost.
